十分钟后，麻辣烫店里。

“……所以，你们是青梅竹马？！”韩小汐按着胸口压惊。

“谁跟他青梅竹马？！”陈雨洁还在犟嘴。

沈轩已经偃旗息鼓了。

韩小汐努力消化着自己刚刚得到的信息。

面前这两个看着八竿子打不到一起的人，从小是邻居。

直到初中毕业，陈雨洁一家才南下，

龙族虽然来得晚却来得非常巧，它们进入内陆的方向，正好是海族登陆的方位。

“别怕。”燕北寒轻轻地拍了拍她的肩膀，她乖巧地靠在他的背后。

被解放出来的四人，虽然有一个还在昏睡另外两个战斗力可以忽略，但单单一个索隆已经让原本大好的局面朝着某个不好的方向发展了。

Ten minutes later, in the Malatang shop.

"...So, you are childhood sweethearts?!" Han Xiaoxi pressed her chest to calm down her shock.

"Who is his childhood sweetheart?!" Chen Yujie was still biting.

Shen Xuan has died down.

Han Xiaoxi tried hard to digest the information she had just received.

The two people in front of them, who looked like they couldn't get along, had been neighbors since childhood.

It wasn't until she graduated from junior high school that Chen Yujie's family moved south.

Although the Dragon Clan arrived late, they arrived very coincidentally. The direction they entered the inland was exactly where the Sea Clan landed.

"Don't be afraid." Yan Beihan patted her shoulder gently, and she leaned behind him obediently.

Of the four people who were liberated, although one was still sleeping and the other two's combat power could be ignored, Sauron alone had already made the originally good situation develop in a bad direction.
